asset_split: SHA256(base asset) mod 5 == 0 withheld from all training; quote aliases share the same split
observation: 35 existing market features plus exposure, holding age, unrealized price return, net wealth relative to initial capital, cash amount, starting capital, minimum/equity and entry affordability (43 inputs)
training: Actual existing SpongeDQN. Matched gamma=0 and gamma=.99 arms; seed41; identical source order and one full mini-batch gradient per <=64-row cohort. Training labels only mature before training_end. Counterfactual branches from fixed expert trajectories, at most26 decisions per training episode. Full states retained.
quotes: Only USD markets enter funded portfolio. All USDC markets collected and counted, but no unverified 1:1 conversion is assumed. Prefer USD for duplicate base assets.
execution: Signals use completed daily candles, next-next daily open fills, full funded accounting. Current catalog minimum notional and base increment applied with explicit current-vintage caveat.
missing_data: No interpolation. Missing held-position marks valued at zero until an actual candle returns; no retroactive exits before gaps. Final missing quote gives zero liquidation value. Invalid lookback prevents new decisions.
selection: All neural arms and losses retained, no choosing a neural winner on evaluation returns. The single expert control is selected using training-only funded net return, and frozen before either evaluation.
qualification: Historical reused data, current-survivor listing bias, no independent profitability or competitor superiority claim. New-to-model asset cohort is distinct from never-before-researched assets.
forward_requirement: Separate future paper observations after frozen source/model selection; not inferred from reused historical periods
amendment: Before opening any new evaluation results: align holding age exactly with delayed fill; expose actual cash, starting capital, minimum/equity and entry affordability. Alternate training episode budgets between 1000 USD and 1000 divided by the current USD catalog size. Prior protocol remains immutable in Git history and its original file.
